intro: Make a statement, even while seated. A bold open mesh back, integrated foam, & sleek contours ensure you stay comfortable while commanding attention—because your seat should be as dynamic as you are.

features.title: The right recline support for you
features.text: The 360° swivel and centre tilt mechanism with adjustable tension help you move naturally while providing steady back support—keeping you active without sacrificing comfort.

features.title: Breathe easy, work better
features.text: Made from injection-moulded glass-filled nylon and high-tenacity mesh fabric, the backrest offers optimal airflow and just the right support—keeping you cool and comfortable during long hours.

features.title: Armrests that adjust to you
features.text: Find the perfect arm position with height-adjustable arms, designed to align with your desk and reduce shoulder strain.

features.title: Lumbar support that adapts
features.text: The adjustable lumbar pad moulds to your lower back, giving you personalised support and helping you maintain healthy posture.

name: Aero Full Back Knitted Fabric Ergonomic Office Chair Black Ink
